messages.subject: Radio Buttons with Images
parts:
Hi,

I would like to incorporate images instead of just text as option names in my radio button group.  Is it possible in Shiny directly?

Sample:

radioButtons("ImageRadio", label="Test Images in Radio", 
choices = c(
tags$img(src="www.xxxxxx.png", width = "100px", height = "100px") = "norm",
tags$img(src="www.yyyyyy.png", width = "100px", height = "100px") = "unif",
tags$img(src="www.zzzzzz.png", width = "100px", height = "100px") = "lnorm",
tags$img(src="www.bbbbbb.png", width = "100px", height = "100px") = "exp"
), 
selected = NULL, 
inline = FALSE, 
width = NULL)

Obviously, the above example does not work and would appreciate a work around

Thank you
SD
